subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexahydridoferrate（[FeH₆]⁴⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Linear
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Fe (group 8) 8 e; 6 × H (X) 6 e; the 4− charge adds 4 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex has a 4− charge, so the metal is Fe(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. As in Mg₂FeH₆, a hydrogen-storage material.
